context.description: Canonical artifacts, runtime ownership and limits

checks.description: Strict TypeScript model and implementation checks
Build from the bound source, then run named semantic and CLI regressions

expectedTests: test#real Node domain + HTTP example and negative control
test#revision preserves old contract and invalidates prior handoff
test#a modified pass flag cannot override malformed saved test output
test#inspect empty project without initialization or mutation
test#client keeps the newest refresh and does not drop a post-write refresh
test#verification failure exposes the check, actual failure and readable log locations
test#real full-stack example verifies HTTP and persistence, not browser approval
test#attachments preserve artifacts and never satisfy an external obligation
test#cold-start fixture runs existing HTTP tests but fails the new product oracle
test#execution preserves symlink invocation identity and child-relative PATH
test#a change to an explicitly declared build directory invalidates old evidence
test#context and checkpoints refresh retained configuration instead of restoring an old index
test#Skill onboarding preserves existing configuration and does not scan generated environments
test#bounded reads allocate by file size and preserve exact-limit and empty-file behavior
test#evaluation arms receive identical raw projects without clinx task guidance
test#bulk boundary oracle accepts a compatible implementation through the actual receiver
test#bulk boundary oracle rejects encoding, capacity, retry and false-success regressions
test#CLI keeps passing baseline evidence separate from unresolved delivery semantics
test#collaboration declarations and a manual pass do not approve an external claim
test#changed confirmation context invalidates local bindings without interpreting approval
test#bounded reads reject a FIFO without waiting for a writer
test#suite-level errors cannot produce a supported CLI claim
test#source entry limits count empty directories as well as files
test#native test output works without JUnit and preserves real assertion failures
test#completed exit 0 survives stdout storage failure without a supported claim
test#interrupted execution and surviving artifacts are retained when archiving fails
test#unexpected execution errors are unknown, never a claim that nothing ran
test#unavailable source roots preserve history while current execution remains blocked
test#receipt definition is self-contained and selector drift does not corrupt historical interpretation
test#corrupt saved source definitions cannot interpret historical pass or support current claims
test#retired checks leave historical observations and handoffs readable but forbid new execution
test#source-owned evidence copies original bytes with qualified identity and survives original removal
test#stored artifact origins must remain unique and inside captured source identity
test#source-only, translation-only and simultaneous edits all require explicit pair review
test#language directories pair nested guides and reject orphan or flat guides
test#hands-on guide JSON runs the documented task without treating passing old tests as product acceptance
test#receipt paths accept the selected workspace alias without accepting inner symlinks or escapes
test#context navigation selects task sources and focus while retaining workspace references
test#workspace navigation binds acceptance only when explicitly referenced as a task input
test#co-located task design is an input while unbound validation notes are outputs
test#workspace Skill onboarding neither requires source guides nor changes source files
test#canonical keys and source paths use locale-independent ordering without Unicode ties
test#JSON diagnostics identify the file without echoing its potentially private contents
test#execution preserves stream order and independently bounds stdout and stderr
test#inspect isolates unusable check directories without discarding valid navigation or executing
